questions.question_text: Which is longer: a $1.62$ m paddle or a $158$ cm paddle?

options.why: Compared 158 with 1.62 without first using a common unit.
Rounded both converted lengths to the nearest metre before comparing, making each $2$ m.
Assumed different units prevent comparison even after conversion.

questions.solution_text:
$1.62\text{ m}=162\text{ cm}$
$162\text{ cm}>158\text{ cm}$
The $1.62$ m paddle is longer.

questions.question_text: Complete with the correct comparison: $740$ mm $\square$ $74$ cm.

options.why: Compared the written numbers without accounting for the different units.
Divided by one hundred rather than ten when changing millimetres to centimetres.
Shifted the decimal point two places instead of one.

questions.question_text: Which order lists the hiking sections from shortest to longest: $1.08$ km, $1075$ m and $1$ km $90$ m?

options.why: Compared the written decimal $1.08$ directly with $1075$ before using a common unit.
Ordered the converted metre values from largest to smallest.
Interpreted $1.08$ km as $1$ km $800$ m, making it appear longest.

questions.solution_text:
$1.08\text{ km}=1080\text{ m}$
$1\text{ km }90\text{ m}=1090\text{ m}$
$1075\text{ m},\ 1.08\text{ km},\ 1\text{ km }90\text{ m}$

questions.question_text: Which branch is longest: $0.56$ m, $54$ cm or $550$ mm?

options.why: Treated $550$ mm as $5.5$ m instead of $0.55$ m.
Rounded every converted length to the nearest whole metre before comparing.

questions.solution_text:
$0.56\text{ m}=560\text{ mm}$
$54\text{ cm}=540\text{ mm}$
$560\text{ mm}>550\text{ mm}>540\text{ mm}$
The $0.56$ m branch is longest.

questions.question_text: Which strip is shortest: $2.04$ m, $203$ cm or $2060$ mm?

options.why: Read $2.04$ m as $2$ m $4$ mm instead of $204$ cm.
Divided millimetres by ten thousand instead of one thousand, making this length look shortest.
Ignored the one-centimetre and two-centimetre differences after conversion.

questions.solution_text:
$2.04\text{ m}=204\text{ cm}$
$2060\text{ mm}=206\text{ cm}$
$203\text{ cm}<204\text{ cm}<206\text{ cm}$
The $203$ cm strip is shortest.

questions.question_text: Omar says $0.101$ km is shorter than $100$ m. Which statement correctly checks his claim?

options.text: Omar is wrong because $0.101\text{ km}=101\text{ m}>100\text{ m}$

options.why: Compared numerical values before expressing them in the same unit.

options.text: Omar is correct because $0.101\text{ km}=10.1\text{ m}$
options.why: Converted kilometres to metres using one hundred instead of one thousand.

options.text: Omar is wrong because $0.101\text{ km}=1001\text{ m}$
options.why: Shifted the decimal point four places instead of three.

questions.solution_text:
$0.101\text{ km}=101\text{ m}$
$101\text{ m}>100\text{ m}$
Omar is wrong.
